args.subject: 18 Brindle Row, Larkspur Vale, ZZ1 1ZZ – evidence needed before invoice NBL-019-INV-11 can be processed
args.body:
Hi Rowan,

Thanks for invoice NBL-019-INV-11 (£174.00, dated 11 September 2025) for 18 Brindle Row, Larkspur Vale, ZZ1 1ZZ.

Our emails of 7 and 8 September asked for a quotation only, with no work to start until we had reviewed the price and issued written authority. We have not issued that authority, and the invoice is a single lump sum with no itemised prices. We can't pass it to the landlord until we have the following:

1. The date you attended and how you got access. The tenant left on 27 August and returned his keys, so please say who gave you access or keys.
2. Before and after photos of each of the six items.
3. An itemised breakdown of the £174.00 and whether VAT applies. Please include the new Venetian blind and the floorboard and carpet work.
4. Confirmation of the scope. Our request listed a cracked chipboard section beside the fireplace and a living-room blind needing repair. Your invoice says you replaced a floorboard and supplied a new blind. Please explain.

Please reply by return. We will not treat the invoice as payable until we have this.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings

args.summary: Contractor claims all six items were completed on 9 Sept and invoiced £174 without a quote or written authority. Asked contractor for access details, date, photos, itemised price/VAT and scope explanation. The invoice is not forwarded to the landlord yet.
facts: Landlord approved proceeding with remedial works, no price limit (event 5)
Provider asked for quote only; no work until written authority (events 7, 8)
Tenant vacated 27 Aug and returned keys; agency held a set (events 3, 7)
No provider reply to chases (events 10, 11); on 10 Sept call Rowan said he had completed the work the previous day (event 13)
Invoice £174.00, single lump sum, no itemisation (remedial-works-invoice.pdf, events 15, 16)
No appointment, access, visit narrative or completion evidence on file (event 15)
conflicts: Contractor says he thought he was instructed to do the work, but the emails asked for a quote only (events 8, 13)
Note in event 12 refers to awaiting an invoice before any invoice existed
Invoice scope (replaced floorboard, new Venetian blind) differs from the request (cracked chipboard, blind needing repair)
Contractor reports work done despite no access arrangement on file and the tenant having left
options_rejected: Forwarding the invoice to the landlord for payment: work is unverified and was done without authority or a quote
Escalating immediately: one message to the contractor can settle access and completion; escalate if the reply is missing or unsatisfactory
Approving the invoice: no approved quote exists
args.uncertainty: The work may not have been done, or may have been done without proper access. The landlord's general approval may cover £174, but the landlord has not yet seen the price.
